title: Self-Pay E-Statement Allowance — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
**Rule.** For a self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account paid off in full, the delivery channel of the account's most recent summary statement, by statement date and, of two on the same date, the one recorded first, sets the self-pay e-statement allowance: patient portal adds 1 percentage point to the self-pay payoff discount percent, email link adds 0.5 percentage points, and U.S. mail or no summary statement adds none.

## Questions answered

**Which statement decides?** The most recent summary statement on the account by statement date; where two share the latest date, the one recorded first. Itemized statements and final notices are not summary statements.

**What does each channel add?** Patient portal 1 point; email link 0.5 points; U.S. mail nothing.

**What if no summary statement has been issued?** Nothing is added.

*Case (hypothetical).* The latest summary statement went by email link and an earlier one by U.S. mail: 0.5 points.
